newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

CYPRUS, Oct 8 - Limassol - three container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 1 conventional vessel discharging at berth 1 vessel anchored waiting to discharge/load 12 due 9/10 of which 4 containers, 2 conventional vessels, 1 cruise ship, 5 passenger. Larnaca - one container vessel discharging/loading at berth, 1 conventional vessel discharging a berth 3 vessels due by 9/10 of which 2 containers, 1 conventional vessel.
GHANA, Oct 7-21 - Tema, Takoradi - no waiting time expected.

ISRAEL, Oct 8 - No labour problems. Haifa - six vessels discharging at berth (4 general cargo, 2 bulkers), 3 containers, 1 tanker, 1 passenger, 7 waiting at anchorage to discharge (1 general cargo, 7 bulkers), 1 container vessel. 2 bunkering, 4 under repairs/dry-docked, 3 awaiting orders, 7 due with 2-4 days delay expected. Ashdod - 11 vessels discharging at berth (10 general cargo, 1 bulker), 1 bulker loading at berth, 1 container, 1 passenger, 2 general cargo vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 container vessel, 1 bunkering. 1-3 days berthing delay expected. Eilat - one car carrier discharging at berth, 1 passenger vessel, 1 bulker waiting at anchor to load 1 due.
JORDAN, Oct 5 - Aqaba three vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge 4 awaiting orders.

MOZAMBIQUE, oct 7 - Nacala - port working normally on first come, first served basis. No restrictions on berthing and sailing at night subject to a gratuity of $150 to be paid to the pilot. Draft restriction 9.5 metres plus height of tide at general cargo berths and 14 metres at container berths. One tugboat available. Beira - general cargo berths working normally on first come, first served basis Container terminal/other terminals working normally. Pilotage restricted to daylight. Two tugs fully operational. Night navigation by special arrangement and restricted to 130 metres loa. Maputo - pilotage restricted to daylight. Two tugs, one out of order. All berths working normally and expected to remain so (first come, first served basis). Draft restriction in the channel is 9.0 metres less 0.5 metres plus rise of tide.
Namibia, Oct 7 - Walvis Bay port working normally.

SIERRA LEONE, Oct 7 - Freetown - no labour problems. Two rice dischargers berthed, operating. 1 vessel under arrest. 5 due (2 container dischargers, 2 rice, 1 container/vehicle discharger), no delays expected. Vessels must endeavour to be in/out of port before 1900 hrs for security reasons.

SOUTH AFRICA, Oct 7 - Richards Bay - general cargo berths working normally. Bulk import sulphur/coking coal congested, delays up to 30 days. Alumina and petcoke discharge berth normal. Bulk export berths normal but congestion expected towards weekend and for next two weeks. Delays of approx 24 hours expected. Bulk coal berths extremely congested, 9 vessels at anchorage awaiting berthing/loading turns and 9 arriving in week. Situation should improve by 14/10. Durban - container terminal delays of up to 72 hours. Point, New Pier/Maydon wharf berths working normally. Maize terminal (Maydon wharf 8) 4 maize loaders for October. Citrus terminal tapering off, season closing. Bunker supplies tight - delays in supplying bunkers expected due to bunching of vessels. Dry/floating dock fully booked for October, 70% booked for November. East London - general cargo/combi terminal berths extremely busy but no delays. Dry-dock fully booked for October/November. Open for bookings from Dec 1. Copper moving in small parcels of 2,500 tonnes/month to far east. Elevator 1 vessel on load berth, another due mid October. Gas oil pipeline under utilised. Wheat imports 2 vessels due, on 11/10 and 16/10. Scrap steel 8,000 tonnes on hand awaiting shipment. Tankers expect to be busy for next 2-3 months. Port Elizabeth - working normally, 4 vessels in port. No delays general, ore, tanker, or fruit berths. Container berths may be under pressure towards end of week but no delays. Cape town breakbulk no delays, vessels working on arrival. Container terminal no delays for coming week. Two new gantry cranes fully operational but a few teething problems. Bunker berths repairs on gasoil lines in Duncan dock area from 9-14/10 and Ben Shoeman area from 16-23/10. Dry-dock, repair quay fully occupied, booking essential. Saldanha Bay working normally.
SYRIA, Sept 28 - Waiting time at Lattakia and Tartous 24 hrs.

TUNISIA, Oct 5 - Gabes - one fertiliser vessel loading at berth, 2 discharging (1 bulk sulphur, 1 ammonia tanker). No vessels anchored. Sousse - no vessels, no delays. Sfax six operating of which 4 discharging (1 fuel oil, 1 bulk maize, 1 bulk sulphur, 1 bulk wheat), 2 loading (1 bagged tsp, 1 bulk rock phosphate). Tunis - one passenger vessel awaiting instructions. 1 discharging marble blocks, 3 general cargo. Rades - one discharging steel billets, 3 ro/ros, 1 loading containers. La Goulette - north side 2 passenger vessels. 1 discharging maize, 1 ro/ro. South side 1 discharging grain, 1 loading zinc blocks. 1 in roads. Oct 7 Bizerte - no delay /congestion/strikes. Seven operating, 3 loading (1 cement, 1 steel, 1 white goods), 4 discharging (1 timber, 1 steel, 1 coke, 1 crude). Zarzis - no vessels, no delay/congestion/strikes.

TURKEY, Oct 8 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa 9 vessels operating, 4 containers, 4 dry cargo, 1 ro/ro. No delays except for heavy lift. Galata 8 cargo/passenger vessels operating, congested. Ambarli 14 operating. No delays. Oct 9 Mersin - 14 operating of which 5 loading (1 marble, 2 cement, 1 wheat, 1 citrus), 6 discharging (1 general cargo, 1 container/general cargo, 1 soda, 2 wheat, 1 sunflower oil), 3 loading/discharging (1 vehicle/general, 1 container/vehicles, 1 beer). Free zone piers 3 discharging, 1 sesame, 1 rice, 1 sugar. Seka - no vessels.

UAE, Sept 29-Oct 5 - Dubai 182 vessels of which 72 containers, 18 general cargo, 2 general cargo/containers, 6 bulkers, 2 car carriers, 17 tankers, 6 naval, 3 uae naval, 1 livestock carrier, 1 bunkering/under repairs/stores etc, 3 dhows, 16 barges, 13 tugs, 17 supply boats, 1 lpg tanker, 2 crane barges, 1 reefer, 1 chemical tanker. 45 Vessels due (32 containers, 8 general cargo, 5 tankers), no delays expected. 5 Loading at berth (4 containers, 1 tanker), 2 general cargo discharging 1 general cargo bunkering, 12 under repair of which 10 tankers, 2 general cargo. No labour problems.

YEMEN, Oct 6 - Hodeidah - all berths occupied except no6, 6 vessels berthed, 2 bulk corn, 1 wheat, 1 flour, 1 steel, 1 timber. No vessels anchored, delays general cargo up to 2 days bagged up to 4 days, bulk cargo up to 6 days, containers up to 1 day. Mokha - no vessels berthed/ anchored, no berthing delays.
